title: Digger
description: Configuration for the Digger .NET debug adapter.

program.description: Path to the program to debug: the built .dll (run with `dotnet`) or the apphost executable.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the program's directory.

env.description: Environment variables to add (null removes a variable).

stopAtEntry.description: Stop at the first line of Main.

console.description: Where the program runs: the debug console (no stdin), or a terminal (stdin works).

justMyCode.description: Only stop and step in code that has symbols and is not optimized.

evaluateProperties.description: Run property getters when expanding objects.

lazyProperties.description: Show properties as click-to-evaluate instead of running every getter on expand.

symbolServer.description: Download missing PDBs from the Microsoft and NuGet symbol servers (cached in ~/.cache/digger).

sourceLink.description: Download sources through Source Link when they are not available locally.

sourceFileMap.description: Maps build-time source path prefixes to local ones, e.g. { "/src": "/home/me/project" }.

dotnetPath.description: The `dotnet` host to run .dll programs with.

logFile.description: Write a Digger diagnostic log to this file.

processId.description: Process id of a running .NET process.
